title: Budget Talk Cut Short in Austin
summary:
*   A special meeting convened to discuss Austin's upcoming 1988-89 operating budget.
*   Departments like Resource Management and Water & Wastewater presented their financial reports.
*   The session was a "worksession" focused on reviewing the city's financial plans for the new fiscal year.
*   The meeting concluded prematurely due to a loss of council quorum.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
For
August 19, 1988 - SPECIAL CALLED MEETING - 1:00 P.M.
Council Chambers, 307 VNfcst Second Street, Austin, Texas Mayor Cooke called to order the
special called meeting of the Council, noting the absence of Councilmember CarlMitchell.
The Mayor announced the purpose of the meeting was to hold a worksession on the operating
budget for FY 1988-89.
Council heard reports from the Resource Management Department and the Water and Wastewater
Department concerning their budgets for the coming fiscal year.
Council lost its quorum at 3:30 P.M. and stopped the special called Council meeting at
3:55 P.M.
